name: Amphotericin B

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States

fda.text: Anaphylaxis has been reported with amphotericin B deoxycholate and other amphotericin B-containing drugs, including amphotericin B liposome for injection. If a severe anaphylactic reaction occurs, the infusion should be immediately discontinued and the patient should not receive further infusions of amphotericin B…

summary: In the United States, Amphotericin B carries a boxed warning [3]. According to the FDA drug label, a severe, life-threatening allergic reaction called anaphylaxis has been reported, and if this occurs, the drug infusion must be stopped right away and never given again [4]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug low risk scores of 34 for the liver and 31 for the heart [M].
